acceptance: The unchanged FCA-00 v1 snapshot inventory and exact-reader-reference API remains content-free, runtime-compatible and byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.

An authorized immutable Forge snapshot file from zero through 16777216 bytes can be fetched as deterministic pages of at most 1000000 bytes, including the 1000001-byte counterexample and the exact maximum.
Every page is bound to one owner, repository, immutable version, commit, snapshot digest, canonical path, file digest, file byte count, authority binding, cursor offset and page size.
Cursor resume never scans a worktree, stores prior content, mints authority or treats a cursor hash as authorization.
Short, zero-progress, overlong, shifted, stale, foreign, mutated or callback-failing range results fail closed with a fresh content-free ForgeSnapshotError.

The implementation changes exactly two paths and passes tests-first, the full FCA-00 suite, the accepted FCA-02 dependency corridor, static zero-effect checks, fresh independent hostile QA and Root/Sol deep review.

cursor_and_page_algorithms.cursor_hash: SHA256(domain odysseus.forge.content_cursor.v2 NUL || u64be(canonical_metadata_bytes_length) || compact sorted-key finite UTF-8 metadata excluding cursor_hash)
cursor_and_page_algorithms.empty_file: Open emits offset zero; the one read requests zero bytes only for the exact zero-byte file, returns an empty terminal page and no next cursor.
cursor_and_page_algorithms.normal_page: expected_length=min(page_bytes,file_byte_count-next_offset); invoke the injected reader exactly once; require exact range identity, exact offset and exact bytes length; derive complete and next cursor locally.
cursor_and_page_algorithms.page_hash: SHA256(domain odysseus.forge.content_page.v2 NUL || u64be(metadata_length) || compact sorted-key finite UTF-8 metadata containing source cursor hash, offset, byte length, page-content SHA256, complete and next-cursor hash)
cursor_and_page_algorithms.resume: A cursor is a content-free immutable checkpoint. It binds the next offset and page size but is non-authorizing and does not prove prior pages were consumed, decoded, retained or hashed.
cursor_and_page_algorithms.terminal: complete is true iff offset+len(content)==file_byte_count; terminal pages expose next_cursor=None; every nonterminal page advances by exactly len(content).

invariants: FCA-00 v1 remains a content-free inventory/reference contract; v2 is additive and uses a separate non-runtime-checkable ForgeResumableContentReader protocol.

Trusted orchestration supplies an authenticated ForgeSnapshotRequest, a matching exact immutable ForgeSnapshotInventory and an injected reader that repeats Forge authorization. This module authenticates none of them.
Open reconstructs exact request, authority, inventory file and cursor values once; read reconstructs them again before the callback and never rereads caller-owned mutable objects afterward.
The cursor path is the inventory's canonical exact path, never the caller alias. Request and inventory owner/repo/version/commit/authority fields must be exactly equal.
The reader receives only the detached request, canonical path, exact next offset and exact bounded expected length. No caller path, branch, HEAD, arbitrary range or worktree flag is forwarded.
A provider range is untrusted until exact-type captured and reconstructed; every identity field must equal the detached request, inventory file and cursor.
Except for the exact empty file, every successful page has positive exact expected length. No short page can advance or terminate the cursor.
The adapter holds only the current immutable bytes page while returning it and stores no session, prior content or cumulative buffer.

Cursor/page hashes bind metadata and current-page digest, not authority or proof of prior-page processing. FCA-03 must independently require every page and surface any read/decode/budget failure as partial or failed.
No page may authorize policy exclusion, coverage completion, indexing, repository selection, provider access or productive activation.

representation.capture: Exact built-in dataclass/scalar gate, single capture into fresh immutable local objects before any reader callback; no Mapping/Sequence protocols or caller object retention.
representation.content: Exact bytes only, one current page, repr-hidden, no to_dict/content projection and no internal retention after return.
representation.cursor: Frozen slotted exact dataclass with content-free to_dict, deterministic hash, canonical file identity, fixed page size and next offset; it contains no authorization reference.
representation.page: Frozen slotted exact dataclass with repr-hidden bytes, source cursor, derived completion, optional next cursor, current-page SHA256 and deterministic page hash.
representation.protocol: New separate ForgeResumableContentReader Protocol; do not modify the accepted runtime-checkable ForgeSnapshotReader protocol.
representation.provider_range: Frozen slotted exact dataclass returned by the injected reader; all identity and range fields are reconstructed and compared before a page is emitted.

target.outcome: One additive ordinary-v2 stateless page boundary lets a future FCA-03 consumer read every byte of one authenticated immutable Forge snapshot file through bounded resumable calls without changing FCA-00 v1 semantics.
target.residual_limit: The cursor is not proof that earlier pages were processed and page hashes are not Merkle proofs of the full file. A consumer that requires an independently recomputed whole-file digest must stream all pages, or restart at offset zero after losing its trusted hashing state.
target.trust_boundary: Forge authenticates the request and supplies the injected exact range reader. This module only detaches, bounds and object-binds its response; it does not authenticate, authorize, access a repository or verify provider attestations.
